name: nuclear-journal
description: Editorial publishing platform for nuclear science, engineering and safety knowledge.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev -w nuclear-journal-server" "npm run dev -w nuclear-journal-client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w nuclear-journal-server && npm run build -w nuclear-journal-client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w nuclear-journal-server && npm run lint -w nuclear-journal-client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w nuclear-journal-server && npm run typecheck -w nuclear-journal-client
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
